name: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones using proven strategies rooted in biology, psychology, and neuroscience.

name: The Fake Out
author: Stephanie Archer
description: A fake-dating, hockey-romance where Hazel and Rory pretend—but feelings get real.

name: The Poppy War
author: R.F. Kuang
description: A dark military fantasy inspired by 20th century Chinese history, following war orphan Rin who discovers an aptitude for shamanism.

name: The Sweetest Oblivion
author: Danielle Lori
description: She's a romantic at heart, living in the most unromantic of worlds... Nicknamed Sweet Abelli for her docile nature, Elena smiles on cue and has a charming response for everything. She's the favored daughter, the perfect mafia principessa... or was.

name: Bride
author: Ali Hazelwood
description: Misery Lark, a Vampyre bride, enters a marriage of convenience with Alpha Werewolf Lowe Moreland to uphold a fragile alliance. But her true motives are personal, and her growing feelings for Lowe complicate everything.

name: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A mystical tale of Santiago, a shepherd boy who follows his dream to discover a treasure and learns profound life lessons along the way.

name: Reckless
author: Elsie Silver
description: Rowdy bull rider. Notorious ladies' man. Trouble wrapped up in a drool-worthy package.

name: King of Wrath
author: Ana Huang
description: A ruthless billionaire meets his match in this arranged marriage romance.

name: The Cruel Prince
author: Holly Black
description: Jude must navigate the dangerous High Court of Faerie while resisting her attraction to the wicked Prince Cardan.

name: Black Ties White Lies
author: Kat Singleton
description: A billionaire romance with secrets and passion.
